title: Keep SLA-risk partial diagnostics within the currently authorized status-filtered Work Queue
goal: Correct a demonstrable Class-0 Work Queue state inconsistency: a readable but status-filtered-out item with unavailable SLA policy must not mark the selected SLA-risk view partial; still report missing policy when it belongs to the requested filtered cohort.
invariants: Command CAP-CMD-101 owns the status-filtered SLA-risk Work Queue view; the authoritative SLA policy/at-risk signal remains with the CAP-CMD-105 provider.
Only the already independently owner-authorized and status-matching cohort can cause sla-policy-unavailable diagnostic; filtered-out, denied, or other-tenant items cannot affect output.
Keep missing SLA policy explicit for an in-filter authorized object, even when its risk membership cannot be asserted; never invent at-risk status, thresholds or a Class-2 mutation.
Same first-party Project, six system views, GET route, paging, source freshness and status filtering; no new ACL, owner calls, routes, dependencies, or production SLA calculation.
security_properties: Existing owner.List and each in-scope Owner.CanRead precede view and status projection; denied/foreign objects do not cause diagnostic side-channels.
No output on provider authorization error; only a boolean diagnostic condition is changed within existing first-party Go projection.
OPEN-013 only affects Class-2 SLA pause/follow-up operations and is expressly OUT OF SCOPE.

migration.rationale: Existing boolean diagnostic condition only; no persisted model, API key, branch format, or source owner changed.

rollback.strategy: Revert only the status guard while preserving the existing authorized SLA-risk projection and Case scopes.
verification: All six Work Queue views still function; preexisting SLA unknown policy behavior remains for the unfiltered view.

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 complete §§1,3,14-17,22,25 and CAP-CMD-105 complete §§8,11-16,22,25; current Engineering CAP-CMD-101 epic and class-0 existing queue implementation.
Git parent PR #169 HEAD b78bb5c5a456883e44718debf897789c24aee86a immutable with exact-head Command and engineering Actions SUCCESS; CI does not imply approved/merged.
Reproduced root cause: Project switch SLARisk sets partialSLA on each authorized item with missing SLAAtRisk before the req.StatusFilter check, even when the item is excluded.
outputs: No sla-policy-unavailable or partial-sources state due only to an owner-authorized SLA-unknown Incident/Task excluded by the selected exact status filter.
Preserve explicit partial warning for matching unknown-SLA items, unfiltered historical behavior, and already-authorized risk rows.
acceptance_tests: Build an authorized open at-risk Incident, authorized closed unknown-SLA Task, denied open unknown-SLA Task and foreign unknown-SLA Incident; with view=sla-risk,status=open show one Incident and state ready without diagnostic.
Selecting view=sla-risk,status=closed still reports partial-sources + sla-policy-unavailable but zero risk rows; unfiltered view remains partial.
The ordinary tasks/status=open projection and authorization calls do not broaden; previous full Work Queue integration tests remain passing.
GitHub exact-head command-work-queue-runtime three OS and mandatory engineering-kernel unchanged security floor 90 plus SAST PASS before any review/merge.

performance_budget.rationale: One existing exact status equality test per already authorized unknown-SLA item; zero extra owner requests or traversals.
metrics: No extra owner.List or CanRead operations; unchanged <=5000 candidates and <=50 visible rows.
No extra time policy calculation, new service, or new network call.

definition_of_ready: E10-CMD-101I-SELECTION IMPLEMENTED; inherited Code Owner and tenant/ACL context unchanged, frozen Git parent #169 exact-head runtime+engineering SUCCESS.
No OPEN decision is needed for a Class-0 diagnostic-filter correctness fix; OPEN-013 prohibits only deferred Class-2 mutations.
definition_of_done: Correction and owner-authorized filter regression included in a bounded PR with exact HEAD CI; only E10-CMD-101J-SLA-FILTER IMPLEMENTED.
No claim CAP-CMD-101 or CAP-CMD-105 accepted, no new external provider, no ancestor SHA updates; L2 not duplicated for minor correction of unchanged model.
